pages.title: Cosmic Eschatology
pages.text: $(thing)Cosmic Eschatology$()$(br2)How does a universe end? Its fate is written in what fills it: matter decelerates the expansion, dark energy accelerates it, and the equation of state w decides whether it freezes, rips or collapses. The first study of Finality.

$(thing)Insight$(): 160$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): The Hot Big Bang, Dark Energy.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Dark Matter Lens.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Whether the expansion of a universe speeds up or slows down depends on what fills it. Take the acceleration of the scale factor, d²a/dt², divided by the scale factor itself: ordinary matter and radiation of density ρ and pressure p pull it back, a vacuum energy Λ pushes it on. Write that relative acceleration.
